content: Letter 24, to Vazīr Amīr Sayyid Zayn al-ʿĀbidīn: a brief note of well-wishing and appreciation for the vizier's support of religion and learning, hoping the spiritual power of Sufis will further his success; like letter 23 it seems to be the opening of a longer letter (TMN/MS p. 19, TMN/D pp. 186-87).
